# Churchtown Media

> Churchtown Media is a small company in Southport, founded by Damian Roche. We build Institrace, a joined index of UK public records, and offer friendly one-to-one help with questions about the record.

## About

Churchtown Media Ltd is based in Churchtown, Southport. Damian Roche founded the company. Its main work is Institrace, a joined index of UK public records. It also offers one-to-one consultation for anyone trying to understand what the public record shows.

Damian also publishes a few local editorial sites about the Sefton Coast, which are run separately.

## What we offer

- Institrace: a joined index of UK public records, for newsrooms, researchers, boards, firms and community groups
- Consultation: a relaxed working session on a question about the public record, followed by a short, clear written note
- Institrace for a team: help getting started with Institrace
